title: App Banner
description: Top-of-app banners composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: an impersonation notice with a way out, a trial countdown with an upgrade and an incident notice with a status link, each tinted by its kind, with an optional dismiss, and its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the actions move beside the message at @sm, the title and description share one line at @md and each dismiss control grows its label at @lg.
